description: Wait a week before adopting a release, so compromised or broken releases are usually pulled first; vulnerability fixes wait 3 days, so a compromised release posing as a fix isn't fast-tracked

customManagers.description: Versions pinned in .make.d (mise itself, Nerd Fonts), each under a '# renovate:' comment
gcloud, installed through mise's http backend
Container test image, pinned by digest like the CI images
zinit, zsh plugins and Oh My Zsh, pinned to commits in _zinit_pins

packageRules.description: mise ships near-daily; take it monthly
The gcloud feed has no release timestamps, which minimumReleaseAge requires
Shell code pins track branch heads (Oh My Zsh moves daily) and git-refs has no timestamps for minimumReleaseAge: one reviewed MR a month instead
Python minor releases can break tools and language servers: take patches only, move minors by hand
TypeScript 7 drops tsserver, which typescript-language-server (Neovim's tools.lua) runs on: stay on 6.x until Neovim moves to TypeScript 7's native language server
poetry's uv.lock holds filelock twice; the old copy is only for Python <3.11, which mise never installs, so Renovate's repeated vulnerability fix can't apply. Poetry bumps re-lock filelock
